summary: Vault 158 recovery PR #614 merged at 99027b67 after its listed check and two independent source reviews passed. The live bot remains unchanged, so treasury-recipient readback and recovery stay held behind separate upgrade and financial authority. ckSOL PR #610 remains green and mergeable but direct running upgrades are unsafe and its reserve stays off. Stability Pool and vault 51 work continue under Bram.
plainSummary: Vault 158 recovery software has been merged after two independent reviews. The live bot has not been upgraded, so its payment destination still cannot be checked and recovery remains held. The Solana processing upgrade issue is unchanged; Stability Pool and vault 51 work continue under Bram, and Rob has no immediate action in this tranche.
